Subject: Launch timeline + marketplace escrow ask

Hi Hannah —

Great to meet you on the call last week. DataBridge is targeting a mid-November launch in the AWS Marketplace and we want to run the joint Sell-With playbook with Redwood. A couple of quick asks to make sure we align before we loop legal/procurement: 

- Can Redwood sign a simple escrow/attestation for co-sell evidence storage for preview buyers?
- What evidence bundle do you require for a managed listing (metering + entitlements + SOC2 attestation)?
- Any objections to a 30-day SOW pilot for select customers (ACME + Nova Labs)?

I attached an assessment sheet that shows our current gaps — the bold items are where we expect help from Redwood.

Thanks — would you be able to confirm a go/no-go by end of week so we can schedule a legal kickoff?

Best,
Amelia
Head of Partnerships, DataBridge
Attachments: DataBridge_SellWith_Assessment.xlsx (Excel, 120KB)

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Suresh Rao <suresh.rao@cloudmarketplace.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Oct 2029 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Launch timeline + marketplace escrow ask

Hi Amelia —

Thanks for the assessment — looks reasonable. Short answers up front: 

1) Escrow/attestation: Redwood can provide a co-sell evidence escrow statement for preview buyers, but legal will need the final SOW language. We typically do a lightweight attestation + evidence retention addendum.
2) Evidence bundle: minimal required set is: SOC 2 report (redacted), metering SKU matrix, entitlement mapping doc, demonstration video, and an automated telemetry sample. Some of that we can supply (SOC 2 + telemetry TTL), the SKU mapping needs your engineering to map to our entitlement model.
3) 30-day SOW pilot: fine by us; commercial to sign off.

I'll loop Ben (sales) and Karthik (partner integrations) to help land the technical checklist and propose a narrow pilot scope. Can we target an internal kickoff Thurs 10/3 at 11am PT? If that works I'll send a calendar invite and include legal templates.

- Hannah
Head of Cloud Partnerships, Redwood Inference
